# BriefMail

> AI-powered email copilot for power users — automated triage, finance tracking, career pipeline, and meeting digests.

## What is BriefMail?

BriefMail is a Next.js 15 web application that connects to your Gmail account via OAuth and automatically:

- **Triages your inbox** into categories (newsletters, receipts, alerts, personal, work) using a multi-tier AI pipeline combining fast heuristic rules with precision language models (Gemini)
- **Extracts financial data** from email receipts and bank statements — surfacing transactions, upcoming EMI payments, SIP investments, and active subscriptions
- **Tracks your career pipeline** — automatically detects job applications, interview invites, and offer letters from email and organises them into a Kanban board
- **Generates meeting digests** — parses calendar invites and meeting emails into structured digests with action items

## Technology Stack

- **Framework**: Next.js 15 (App Router, React 19)
- **Auth**: Clerk (Google OAuth + email)
- **Database**: Supabase (Postgres with Row Level Security)
- **AI**: Google Gemini (multi-key load-balanced), Hugging Face models
- **Queue**: Redis (Upstash in production) + custom batch processing
- **Deployment**: Vercel (with cron jobs for keepalive and batch processing)
- **Styling**: Tailwind CSS with a custom editorial design system

## URL

https://briefmail.vercel.app

## What BriefMail does NOT do

- It does not send emails on your behalf
- It does not store email body content permanently — only structured metadata is persisted
- It does not share your data with third parties
- It does not support email clients other than Gmail at this time

## Key Pages (public)

- `/` — Landing page with feature overview and sign-up
- `/sign-in` — Clerk-powered sign in (Google OAuth or email)
- `/sign-up` — Account creation

## Key Pages (authenticated, noindex)

- `/inbox` — AI-triaged email inbox
- `/finance` — Financial data dashboard
- `/career` — Job application Kanban board
- `/meetings` — Meeting digests and calendar
- `/all-mail` — Full email archive
- `/settings` — Account and sync configuration

## API

All API routes are under `/api/` and require Clerk authentication (except cron and webhook endpoints).

## Contact

For questions about BriefMail, see the repository README or open an issue on GitHub.
